purpose: Frozen anchor-specific CAIS proxy-fitness rubrics defined before candidate-level fitness scoring.

score_scale.0: No evidence that the candidate supports the requirement

adequacy_rule.critical_requirement_rule: No critical requirement may receive a score of 0

requirements.name: Workflow and dependency-graph execution
requirements.description: Supports construction or testing of multi-step workflows, DAGs, dependency graphs, or equivalent execution relationships.

requirements.name: Failure recovery and retry semantics
requirements.description: Supports testing retry, recovery, failure propagation, restart, or equivalent resilience behavior.

requirements.name: Connector and integration behavior
requirements.description: Supports integration with external data sources, services, connectors, or heterogeneous components.

requirements.name: Scheduling and execution semantics
requirements.description: Supports scheduled, triggered, queued, or coordinated execution behavior.

requirements.name: Pipeline or data consistency
requirements.description: Supports testing consistency or correctness of data or state as it moves through a workflow.

requirements.name: Operational observability
requirements.description: Provides logging, monitoring, task state, metrics, or equivalent evidence useful for observing workflow behavior.

requirements.name: Model loading and inference
requirements.description: Supports loading trained models and executing inference or prediction.

requirements.name: Training or fine-tuning
requirements.description: Supports model training, adaptation, or fine-tuning workflows.

requirements.name: Distributed or accelerated execution
requirements.description: Supports distributed, multi-device, GPU, sharded, or otherwise accelerated model execution.

requirements.name: Model artifact or hub compatibility
requirements.description: Supports reusable model artifacts, checkpoints, registries, hubs, or comparable model distribution mechanisms.

requirements.name: Multi-task or multimodal capability
requirements.description: Supports multiple model tasks, modalities, architectures, or configurable model families.

requirements.name: Configuration and preprocessing reproducibility
requirements.description: Captures model configuration, preprocessing, tokenizer/processor behavior, or comparable reproducibility information.

anchors.role: Distributed AI execution, training, and serving

requirements.name: Distributed execution
requirements.description: Supports execution of work across multiple workers, processes, nodes, or distributed resources.

requirements.name: Fault tolerance and recovery
requirements.description: Supports worker, process, task, node, or job failure handling and recovery.

requirements.name: Distributed model training
requirements.description: Supports scalable or distributed model-training workloads.

requirements.name: Model inference or serving
requirements.description: Supports deployment, serving, online inference, or distributed prediction.

requirements.name: Resource and accelerator scheduling
requirements.description: Supports allocation or scheduling of CPU, GPU, memory, or other constrained resources.

requirements.name: Parallel pipeline or task execution
requirements.description: Supports task, pipeline, actor, stage, or equivalent parallel execution structures.

anchors.role: Model lifecycle, experiment tracking, registry, and deployment

requirements.name: Experiment and run tracking
requirements.description: Records model-development runs, parameters, metrics, outputs, or equivalent experimental evidence.

requirements.name: Model lineage and version management
requirements.description: Supports model versioning, lineage, provenance, registration, or controlled lifecycle transitions.

requirements.name: Artifact and dependency reproducibility
requirements.description: Captures model artifacts, dependencies, environment information, or packaging needed to reproduce execution.

requirements.name: Deployment and serving
requirements.description: Supports deployment of models to an inference endpoint or comparable execution environment.

requirements.name: Validation or promotion workflow
requirements.description: Supports validation state, approval, promotion, aliasing, staging, or comparable model-governance workflow.

requirements.name: Metadata and artifact retrieval
requirements.description: Provides structured retrieval of runs, models, metadata, artifacts, or associated evidence.

anchors.role: Computer vision object detection and related vision workloads

requirements.name: Object detection or localization inference
requirements.description: Supports detection, localization, segmentation, or equivalent spatial prediction from visual inputs.

requirements.name: Vision-model training or fine-tuning
requirements.description: Supports training or adapting computer-vision models on labeled datasets.

requirements.name: Quantitative validation
requirements.description: Supports repeatable evaluation using accuracy, precision/recall, mAP, loss, or comparable performance metrics.

requirements.name: Model export and runtime portability
requirements.description: Supports export or execution across alternate model formats, frameworks, accelerators, or inference runtimes.

requirements.name: Input and inference variability
requirements.description: Supports testing across different images, streams, sizes, sources, batch conditions, or inference configurations.

requirements.name: Multiple vision task modes
requirements.description: Supports more than one related vision task such as detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, or equivalent.

anchors.role: Face recognition, verification, and facial analysis

requirements.name: Face detection and representation
requirements.description: Supports detecting faces and producing representations, embeddings, or equivalent identity-oriented features.

requirements.name: Identity verification or matching
requirements.description: Supports comparing identities using similarity, distance, thresholds, verification, or recognition.

requirements.name: Spoofing or authenticity resistance
requirements.description: Supports anti-spoofing, liveness, authenticity checking, or equivalent presentation-attack testing.

requirements.name: Model or detector variability
requirements.description: Supports multiple models, detector backends, recognition approaches, or configurable processing pipelines.

requirements.name: Threshold and confidence behavior
requirements.description: Supports threshold, confidence, distance, calibration, or comparable decision-boundary evaluation.

requirements.name: Service or application integration
requirements.description: Supports API, service, database, streaming, or application-level integration of face-analysis functionality.

anchors.role: Financial data aggregation and analytical decision support

requirements.name: Financial or market data ingestion
requirements.description: Supports acquisition of market, economic, company, asset, or comparable financial-domain data.

requirements.name: Financial analytics or time-series analysis
requirements.description: Supports analytical operations on financial, market, quantitative, or time-series information.

requirements.name: Multiple data-provider integration
requirements.description: Supports multiple providers, APIs, adapters, connectors, or interchangeable data sources.

requirements.name: Data provenance and reproducibility
requirements.description: Provides evidence of data source, parameters, timestamps, transformations, or other provenance needed to reproduce analysis.

requirements.name: Programmatic automation
requirements.description: Supports APIs, SDKs, scripts, pipelines, or automated analytical workflows.

requirements.name: Missing, delayed, or provider-error handling
requirements.description: Supports testing behavior when financial data are unavailable, incomplete, delayed, malformed, or provider access fails.

anchors.role: Model interchange, validation, and runtime portability

requirements.name: Model serialization and interchange
requirements.description: Supports a portable model representation or conversion/interchange between model-producing and model-consuming systems.

requirements.name: Operator and schema compatibility
requirements.description: Supports explicit operators, schemas, graph structures, or compatibility rules governing model execution.

requirements.name: Model validation or checking
requirements.description: Supports validation of model structure, graph integrity, schema compliance, or equivalent correctness checks.

requirements.name: Shape and type inference
requirements.description: Supports propagation or validation of tensor shapes, types, dimensions, or equivalent interface contracts.

requirements.name: Runtime or backend interoperability
requirements.description: Supports execution or compatibility across multiple runtimes, frameworks, hardware targets, or backends.

requirements.name: Version and compatibility evolution
requirements.description: Supports model-format, operator-set, schema, or version compatibility testing across releases.
